sentences.text: Mary of Teck -LRB- Victoria Mary Augusta Louise Olga Pauline Claudine Agnes ; 26 May 1867 -- 24 March 1953 -RRB- was Queen of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions and Empress of India as the wife of King-Emperor George V.	British Dominions	British Dominions	George V	George V	Teck	Teck	Queen	List of British consorts	United Kingdom	United Kingdom	Empress of India	Empress of India	George	George V
Although technically a princess of Teck , in the Kingdom of Württemberg , she was born and raised in England .	Teck	Teck	Kingdom of Württemberg	Kingdom of Württemberg	England	England

Her parents were Francis , Duke of Teck , who was of German extraction , and Princess Mary Adelaide of Cambridge , a granddaughter of King George III .	Teck	Teck	Princess Mary Adelaide of Cambridge	Princess Mary Adelaide of Cambridge	George III	George III	George	George V
She was informally known as `` May '' , after her birth month .

At the age of 24 , she was betrothed to Prince Albert Victor , Duke of Clarence and Avondale , the eldest son of the Prince of Wales , but six weeks after the announcement of the engagement , he died unexpectedly of pneumonia .	Prince of Wales	Edward VII	pneumonia	pneumonia	Albert	George VI
The following year , she became engaged to Albert Victor 's next surviving brother , George , who subsequently became king .	George	George V	Albert	George VI

Before her husband 's accession , she was successively Duchess of York , Duchess of Cornwall , and Princess of Wales .	Duchess of York	Duchess of York	Duchess of Cornwall	Duchess of Cornwall	Princess of Wales	Princess of Wales

As queen consort from 1910 , she supported her husband through World War I , his ill health and major political changes arising from the aftermath of the war , and the rise of socialism and nationalism .	queen consort	queen consort	World War I	World War I	aftermath of the war	Aftermath of World War I

After George 's death in 1936 , she became queen mother when her eldest son , Edward , ascended the throne , but to her dismay , he abdicated later the same year in order to marry twice-divorced American socialite Wallis Simpson .	George	George V	queen mother	queen mother	Edward	Edward VIII	abdicated	Edward VIII abdication crisis	Wallis Simpson	Wallis Simpson
She supported her second son , Albert , who succeeded to the throne as George VI , until his death in 1952 .	George VI	George VI	George	George V	Albert	George VI
She died the following year , during the reign of her granddaughter Queen Elizabeth II , who had not yet been crowned .	Queen	List of British consorts	Queen Elizabeth II	Queen Elizabeth II
